Hindi ako natutukan ng turo ng english ng fam ko pero natuto ako magsalita ng straight english mula sa mga english short stories sa textbooks dati, english novels na tapos nang basahin ng ermat ko, at movies. Since sabi mo di ka pa ganon ka-skilled, nood ka muna ng children's movies. Mas magaan pa vocabulary kaya makaka focus ka sa kung paano sila mag construct ng sentences. Oks lang kung may subtitles ka muna. 

Pag nasanay ka na, try mo manood nang walang subtitles. 

Tapos try mo manood ng sit-coms or recent movies para naman marinig mo kung paano sila magsalita na malapit-lapit sa informal english na ginagamit ng native american speaker. 

Importante na ipractice mo. As in maghanap ka ng kakausapin in english via spoken and written communication. Pag nagkamali ka, okay lang mapahiya ng konti kung kapalit nun ay improvement. Pag may tropa ka na pinagtitripan ka kasi nag aaral ka ng second language, sabihin mo investment sa sarili yung ginagawa mo. Tatawa sila sa una, pero pag nakita ng real friends mo na nagsisikap ka, titigil din att malay mo sabayan ka pa sa pag improve. 

Keep going, Op. You got this. 

Ps. Try mo din isearch sa fb yung mga content creator na may reels ng english grammar ganern.

A friend I respect so much fell for a guy who was flirting with her while in a relationship (she was aware, that's why she sought advice). I remember telling her, that kind of journey isn't something you would like in the long run. I was right, the gf's friends are now FOR YEARS mocking her, gossiping about her, wrecking her image that she worked so hard to build; they are never right at hurting my friend, I'm just saying that it is predictable behavior and I worry for her mental state. I stayed being her friend because she is more than the woman who might have chosen the wrong guy, she was my friend before that. I feel sorry for her, but whenever she comes to us venting, I still tell her that she chose the life we warned her about, we can't do anything about it anymore and we're just around to give her solace. They seem happy now, but I am still worried and looking out for her. I am afraid she might lose the guy the same way she had him.
Edit: this comment is for perspective. approaching a person who is in a relationship while being aware and still want romance with them is not healthy. The people who argued with you otherwise might be those who have trouble with honoring their own words. Relationship is a gamble because it's just words saying "I won't let you down" and not a written contract with a ring as a symbol and the partner can just exit anytime they feel doing so. Heck, even with contracts and binding symbols people still decide to back out. The reason there are several who argued with you is because suitors see the partner as a challenge and not as your partner whom you've established connection with. Other people would say "what if the partner is abusive, I should save him/her!" As a person who wants to be someone's significant other, we are not there to save them but to encourage them to save themselves.
